light.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a text-free illustration for a database field guide. Input image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its restrained technical sketch, fine lightly imperfect graphite contours, small selective pencil hatching, shallow paper-card depth, muted blue/teal washes and nearly smooth warm ivory paper. This is carefully hand-drawn explanatory art, not polished flat vectors, not a heavy textured 3D render. Landscape aspect 4:3.
Exact composition designed for later HTML labels: left a large blank frontal record card rectangle x6%-40%, y27%-77%, with just a fine sketched perimeter and thin second-sheet edge. Interior completely blank for a name, price, stock and photo-name list added in HTML. Right a frontal photograph print rectangle x62%-94%, y27%-77%, showing one beautifully drawn blue ceramic mug with round handle, occupying the middle, plenty of margin. Clearly this is a photograph/image object rather than a physical mug loose on the page. Between them one fine teal horizontal right-pointing arrow from x41% y63% to x60% y63%. Top y0%-25% blank for HTML group headings. Bottom y79%-100% blank for HTML filename and caption labels. No other objects, no text whatsoever, no decorative lines inside the blank card, no rounded button boxes. Labels will be placed in HTML, so blank regions are essential. Match the reference's sketch quality and delicate washed blue ceramic mug.

dark.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Make a matched DARK THEME companion of the supplied restrained technical sketch. Change ONLY paper, strokes, shading and wash colours. Keep every object, edge, connector, arrowhead, highlighted portion, empty label space and overall composition at exactly the same position and size. Background is nearly smooth warm charcoal paper (#292720), graphite lines become light warm pencil lines, paper faces become slightly lighter warm charcoal. Keep blue, teal and ochre colour identities as soft muted washes, with enough contrast to understand all objects. Preserve delicate selective pencil hatching and shallow card edges. No inversion effect, no dramatic lighting, no glows, no heavy grain. NO TEXT. Preserve original aspect ratio and dimensions. This is a careful dark-paper technical sketch of the identical scene.

assets.validation: Inspected both originals. One empty record card, one photograph of a blue mug, one rightward naming arrow. Geometry is shared between themes. All data labels are HTML.
